## Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
rm(list = ls()) # Clean environment
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(rlang)


# Set base theme
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 14))

# Create output_dir once
output_dir <- file.path("R_output", "Endosymbiont_Stack_Plots")
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

```

## Load data

```{r load-data}
load("R_output/ps_objects/GrandRiverMB_phyloseq_filt_unnorm.RData")


#filter for endosymbiont genera of interest
# List of endosymbiont genera of interest
endo_genera <- c(
  "Buchnera", "Candidatus Cardinium", "Rickettsia", "Wolbachia",
  "Spiroplasma", "Diplorickettsia", "Candidatus Hamiltonella",
  "Candidatus Megaira", "Candidatus Regiella", "Rickettsiella"
)

endo_genera <- c(
  # Core well-known insect endosymbionts
  "Wolbachia", "Rickettsia", "Rickettsiella", "Diplorickettsia",
  "Spiroplasma", "Arsenophonus", "Serratia", 
  "Candidatus_Hamiltonella", "Candidatus_Regiella",
  "Candidatus_Cardinium", "Candidatus_Megaira",

  # Obligate or host-restricted symbionts (may appear if filtering less strict)
  "Buchnera", "Sulcia", "Hodgkinia", "Nasuia",

  # Additional reproductive manipulators / heritable pathogens
  "Candidatus_Midichloria", "Candidatus_Lariskella",
  
  # Potential persistent facultative / context-dependent symbionts
  "Microsporidia", "Nosema", "Vavraia", "Encephalitozoon"
)

```

# Stacked Barplot Endosymbionts

## Flexible plotting function

```{r plotting-function}
plot_endosymbiont_stack <- function(
  ps_object,
  taxrank = "Genus",
  grouping_vars = "Location",
  facet_by = NULL,
  output_dir,
  y_limit = NULL,          # New argument for y-axis max limit, e.g. 0.3 for 30%
  width = 10,
  height = 6
) {
  
  # Agglomerate to taxrank
  ps_tax <- tax_glom(ps_object, taxrank = taxrank, NArm = FALSE)
  
  # OTU table
  otu <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_tax))
  if (taxa_are_rows(ps_tax)) otu <- t(otu)
  
  # Taxonomy
  tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_tax))
  tax_labels <- tax_df[[taxrank]]
  tax_labels[is.na(tax_labels)] <- "Unknown"
  tax_labels <- gsub(" ", "_", tax_labels)
  colnames(otu) <- tax_labels
  
  # Relative abundance per sample
  otu_rel <- otu / rowSums(otu)
  otu_rel[is.na(otu_rel)] <- 0
  
  # Filter to endosymbionts only
otu_rel_endo <- otu_rel[, colnames(otu_rel) %in% endo_genera, drop = FALSE]

# Find highest abundance value
max_abundance <- max(otu_rel_endo)

# Print in % for your plot height
max_percent <- max_abundance * 100

cat("Max endosymbiont abundance across dataset:", round(max_percent, 2), "%\n")
  

y_limit <- ceiling(max_abundance * 1.1 * 10) / 10  # round up to next 0.1


  # Metadata
  meta <- as(sample_data(ps_tax), "data.frame")
  
  # Enforce factor levels if present
  if ("Location" %in% colnames(meta)) {
    meta$Location <- factor(meta$Location, levels = c("UP", "DWN"))
  }
  if ("Taxa" %in% colnames(meta)) {
    meta$Taxa <- factor(meta$Taxa, levels = c("Chironomidae", "Heptageniidae", "Hydropsychidae", "Araneid", "Tetragnatha"))
  }
  if ("Lifestage" %in% colnames(meta)) {
    meta$Lifestage <- factor(meta$Lifestage, levels = c("Larvae", "Adult", "Spider"))
  }
  
  # Align samples between otu_rel and meta
  shared_ids <- intersect(rownames(otu_rel), rownames(meta))
  otu_rel <- otu_rel[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  meta <- meta[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Long format of all taxa
  plot_df <- otu_rel %>%
    as_tibble(rownames = "SampleID") %>%
    pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to = "Taxon", values_to = "Abundance") %>%
    left_join(meta %>% rownames_to_column("SampleID"), by = "SampleID")
  
  # Keep only the endosymbiont taxa
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(Taxon %in% endo_genera)
  
# sum  upendosymbiont abundances per sample
plot_df_agg <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(SampleID, !!!syms(grouping_vars)) %>%
  summarise(
    total_endo_abundance = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# relative contributions within endosymbionts
plot_df_taxa <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(SampleID, !!!syms(grouping_vars), Taxon) %>%
  summarise(
    taxon_abundance = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(plot_df_agg, by = c("SampleID", grouping_vars)) %>%
  mutate(
    taxon_prop_within_endo = ifelse(total_endo_abundance > 0,
                                     taxon_abundance / total_endo_abundance,
                                     0)
  )

# compute mean *total_endo_abundance* per group and mean *taxon_prop_within_endo* per group
summary_df <- plot_df_taxa %>%
  group_by(!!!syms(c(grouping_vars, "Taxon"))) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_total_endo_abundance = mean(total_endo_abundance),
    mean_taxon_prop_within_endo = mean(taxon_prop_within_endo),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_abundance = mean_total_endo_abundance * mean_taxon_prop_within_endo
  )
  
  # gplot
  p <- ggplot(
    summary_df,
    aes(
      x = .data[[grouping_vars[1]]],
      y = mean_abundance,
      fill = Taxon
    )
  ) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02)),
      limits = c(0, y_limit)   # set y limit if provided
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Stacked Relative Abundance of Endosymbionts (", taxrank, ")"),
      y = "Mean Relative Abundance (%)",
      x = grouping_vars[1],
      fill = taxrank
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  # facet with multiple variables as subfacets
  if (!is.null(facet_by)) {
    facet_formula <- as.formula(paste("~", paste(facet_by, collapse = "+")))
    p <- p + facet_wrap(facet_formula, scales = "free")
  }
  
  # create output file names
  filename_base <- paste0(
    "Stacked_RA_Endosymbionts_", taxrank, "_",
    paste(grouping_vars, collapse = "_"),
    if (!is.null(facet_by)) paste0("_facet_", paste(facet_by, collapse = "_")) else ""
  )
  
  # saving plots
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(filename_base, ".png")),
    plot = p,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(filename_base, ".pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = width,
    height = height
  )
  
  message("Saved stacked plot as PNG and PDF: ", filename_base)
  
  return(p)
}
```

## Plot

Select the following:

taxrank: e.g. "Species", "Genus" etc

grouping_vars: select grouping variables based on which mean relative abundances are calculated e.g., Location, Lifestage, Taxa or multiple in vector

facet_by (needs to be included in grouping_vars)

```{r}
#see arguments of function
args(plot_endosymbiont_stack)


# Example:
 p <- plot_endosymbiont_stack(
  ps_object = ps_final,
  taxrank = "Genus",
  grouping_vars = c("Location", "Lifestage", "Taxa"),
  facet_by = c("Taxa", "Lifestage"),
  output_dir = output_dir,
  y_limit =0.6,    # dynamically set
  width = 12,
  height = 8
)
p
```

# Ind. bars + SE barlot of Endosymbionts

## Flexible plotting functions

Total

```{r}
plot_endosymbiont_barplot2 <- function(
    ps_object,
    taxrank = "Genus",
    grouping_vars = c("Location"),
    facet_by = NULL,
    output_dir = NULL,
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    save_plot = FALSE
) {
    require(tidyverse)
    require(phyloseq)
    require(scales)
    
    # aggregate
    ps_tax <- tax_glom(ps_object, taxrank = taxrank, NArm = FALSE)
    
    # OTU table
    otu <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_tax))
    if (taxa_are_rows(ps_tax)) otu <- t(otu)
    
    # tax labels
    tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_tax))
    tax_labels <- tax_df[[taxrank]]
    tax_labels[is.na(tax_labels)] <- "Unknown"
    tax_labels <- gsub(" ", "_", tax_labels)
    colnames(otu) <- tax_labels
    
    # rel abundance
    otu_rel <- otu / rowSums(otu)
    otu_rel[is.na(otu_rel)] <- 0
    
    # metadata
    meta <- as(sample_data(ps_tax), "data.frame")
    if ("Location" %in% colnames(meta)) {
        meta$Location <- factor(meta$Location, levels = c("UP", "DWN"))
    }
    if ("Taxa" %in% colnames(meta)) {
        meta$Taxa <- factor(meta$Taxa, levels = c("Chironomidae", "Heptageniidae", "Hydropsychidae", "Araneid", "Tetragnatha"))
    }
    if ("Lifestage" %in% colnames(meta)) {
        meta$Lifestage <- factor(meta$Lifestage, levels = c("Larvae", "Adult", "Spider"))
    }
    
    # align
    shared_ids <- intersect(rownames(otu_rel), rownames(meta))
    otu_rel <- otu_rel[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
    meta <- meta[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # long format
    plot_df <- otu_rel %>%
        as_tibble(rownames = "SampleID") %>%
        pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to = "Taxon", values_to = "Abundance") %>%
        left_join(meta %>% rownames_to_column("SampleID"), by = "SampleID")
    
    # filter to endosymbionts
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
        filter(Taxon %in% endo_genera)
    
    if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
        message("No endosymbiont taxa present at ", taxrank, " level in the dataset.")
        return(NULL)
    }
    
    # sum abundance across endosymbionts for total endo abundance per sample
    plot_df_sum <- plot_df %>%
        group_by(SampleID, !!!syms(grouping_vars)) %>%
        summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")
    
    # calc mean and SE per group
    summary_df <- plot_df_sum %>%
        group_by(!!!syms(grouping_vars)) %>%
        summarise(
            mean_abundance = mean(Abundance),
            se_abundance = sd(Abundance) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop"
        )
    
    # determine dynamic y-axis limit with 20% headroom
    max_mean <- max(summary_df$mean_abundance)
    y_limit <- min(1, max_mean * 1.2)
    
    #plotting
    p <- ggplot(summary_df, aes_string(
        x = grouping_vars[1],
        y = "mean_abundance",
        fill = grouping_vars[1]
    )) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
                 color = "black", alpha = 0.85) +
        geom_errorbar(
            aes(
                ymin = pmax(0, mean_abundance - se_abundance),
                ymax = mean_abundance + se_abundance
            ),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
            width = 0.2
        ) +
        scale_y_continuous(
            labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1),
            expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02)),
            limits = c(0, y_limit)
        ) +
        labs(
            title = paste0("Total Endosymbiont Relative Abundance (", taxrank, ")"),
            y = "Relative Abundance (%)",
            x = grouping_vars[1],
            fill = grouping_vars[1]
        ) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
        theme(
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            legend.position = "right"
        )
    
    if (!is.null(facet_by)) {
        facet_formula <- as.formula(paste("~", paste(facet_by, collapse = "+")))
        p <- p + facet_wrap(facet_formula, scales = "free_y", nrow = 4)
    }
    
  
    if (save_plot && !is.null(output_dir)) {
        filename_base <- paste0(
            "TOTAL_Barplot_RA_Endosymbionts_", taxrank, "_",
            paste(grouping_vars, collapse = "_"),
            if (!is.null(facet_by)) paste0("_facet_", paste(facet_by, collapse = "_")) else ""
        )
        
        ggsave(
            filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(filename_base, ".png")),
            plot = p,
            width = width,
            height = height,
            dpi = 300
        )
        
        ggsave(
            filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(filename_base, ".pdf")),
            plot = p,
            width = width,
            height = height
        )
        
        message("Saved barplot as PNG and PDF: ", filename_base)
    }
    
    return(p)
}
```

Individual

```{r}
plot_endosymbiont_barplot_individual <- function(
    ps_object,
    taxrank = "Genus",
    grouping_vars = c("Location"),
    facet_by = NULL,
    output_dir = NULL,
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    save_plot = FALSE,
    free_y_in_facets = TRUE
) {
    require(tidyverse)
    require(phyloseq)
    require(scales)
    
    # agglomerate
    ps_tax <- tax_glom(ps_object, taxrank = taxrank, NArm = FALSE)
    
    # OTU table
    otu <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_tax))
    if (taxa_are_rows(ps_tax)) otu <- t(otu)
    
    # tax labels
    tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_tax))
    tax_labels <- tax_df[[taxrank]]
    tax_labels[is.na(tax_labels)] <- "Unknown"
    tax_labels <- gsub(" ", "_", tax_labels)
    colnames(otu) <- tax_labels
    
    # rel abundance
    otu_rel <- otu / rowSums(otu)
    otu_rel[is.na(otu_rel)] <- 0
    
    # metadata
    meta <- as(sample_data(ps_tax), "data.frame")
    if ("Location" %in% colnames(meta)) {
        meta$Location <- factor(meta$Location, levels = c("UP", "DWN"))
    }
    if ("Taxa" %in% colnames(meta)) {
        meta$Taxa <- factor(meta$Taxa, levels = c("Chironomidae", "Heptageniidae", "Hydropsychidae", "Araneid", "Tetragnatha"))
    }
    if ("Lifestage" %in% colnames(meta)) {
        meta$Lifestage <- factor(meta$Lifestage, levels = c("Larvae", "Adult", "Spider"))
    }
    
    # algining
    shared_ids <- intersect(rownames(otu_rel), rownames(meta))
    otu_rel <- otu_rel[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
    meta <- meta[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # long format
    plot_df <- otu_rel %>%
        as_tibble(rownames = "SampleID") %>%
        pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to = "Taxon", values_to = "Abundance") %>%
        left_join(meta %>% rownames_to_column("SampleID"), by = "SampleID")
    
    # filter to endosymbionts
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
        filter(Taxon %in% endo_genera)
    
    if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
        message("No endosymbiont taxa present at ", taxrank, " level in the dataset.")
        return(NULL)
    }
    
    # calc mean ± SE per group and taxon
    summary_df <- plot_df %>%
        group_by(!!!syms(c(grouping_vars, "Taxon", facet_by))) %>%
        summarise(
            mean_abundance = mean(Abundance),
            se_abundance = sd(Abundance) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop"
        )
    
    # yaxis limits
    if (!free_y_in_facets) {
        # Single global limit
        max_mean <- max(summary_df$mean_abundance + summary_df$se_abundance)
        y_limit <- min(1, max_mean * 1.15)
        y_scale <- scale_y_continuous(
            labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1),
            expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0)),
            limits = c(0, y_limit)
        )
    } else {
        # Per-facet limit: headroom = 15% above the tallest bar+SE in each facet
        facet_limits <- summary_df %>%
            group_by(!!!syms(facet_by)) %>%
            summarise(
                y_max = min(1, max(mean_abundance + se_abundance, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15),
                .groups = "drop"
            )
        summary_df <- summary_df %>%
            left_join(facet_limits, by = facet_by)
        
       
        y_scale <- scale_y_continuous(
            labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1),
            expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
        )
    }
#plot
    p <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(
        x = .data[[grouping_vars[1]]],
        y = mean_abundance,
        fill = Taxon
    )) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity",
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
                 color = "black",
                 alpha = 0.85) +
        geom_errorbar(
            aes(
                ymin = pmax(0, mean_abundance - se_abundance),
                ymax = mean_abundance + se_abundance
            ),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
            width = 0.2
        ) +
        # invisible points to set ceiling for plto
        { if (free_y_in_facets)
            geom_blank(aes(y = y_max))
          else
            NULL
        } +

        y_scale +
        labs(
            title = paste0("Endosymbiont Relative Abundance (", taxrank, ")"),
            y = "Relative Abundance (%)",
            x = grouping_vars[1],
            fill = taxrank
        ) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
        theme(
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            legend.position = "right"
        )
    
    if (!is.null(facet_by)) {
        facet_formula <- as.formula(paste("~", paste(facet_by, collapse = "+")))
        p <- p + facet_wrap(
            facet_formula,
            scales = if (free_y_in_facets) "free_y" else "fixed",
            nrow = 4
        )
    }
    
    # saving
    if (save_plot && !is.null(output_dir)) {
        filename_base <- paste0(
            "IND_Barplot_RA_Endosymbionts_", taxrank, "_",
            paste(grouping_vars, collapse = "_"),
            if (!is.null(facet_by)) paste0("_facet_", paste(facet_by, collapse = "_")) else "",
            if (free_y_in_facets) "_freeY" else "_fixedY"
        )
        ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(filename_base, ".png")), plot = p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
        ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(filename_base, ".pdf")), plot = p, width = width, height = height)
        message("Saved barplot as PNG and PDF: ", filename_base)
    }
    
    return(list(plot = p, plot_df = plot_df))
}
```

# Test for significant differences in total endosymbiont abundances

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# compute total endosymbiont abundance per sample, life stage, and taxon
total_endo <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(SampleID, Lifestage, Taxa, Location) %>%
  summarise(Total_Endosymbiont = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

overall_total_endo <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(Lifestage, Taxa, Location) %>%
  summarise(Total_Endosymbiont = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")
overall_total_endo

#all combinations of Lifestage and Taxa
combinations <- total_endo %>%
  distinct(Lifestage, Taxa)

# Kruskal-Wallis for each combination
kw_results <- combinations %>%
  pmap_df(function(Lifestage, Taxa){
    
    data_subset <- total_endo %>%
      filter(Lifestage == !!Lifestage, Taxa == !!Taxa)
    
    # Only run test if both locations have data
    if(length(unique(data_subset$Location)) > 1){
      test <- kruskal.test(Total_Endosymbiont ~ Location, data = data_subset)
      tibble(
        Lifestage = Lifestage,
        Taxa = Taxa,
        chi_sq = test$statistic,
        df = test$parameter,
        p_value = test$p.value
      )
    } else {
      tibble(
        Lifestage = Lifestage,
        Taxa = Taxa,
        chi_sq = NA,
        df = NA,
        p_value = NA
      )
    }
  })

# adj p-values for multiple testing (Benjamini-Hochberg)
kw_results <- kw_results %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

kw_results

```
